package.name: zed_msgs
package.description: Subset of the Stereolabs zed_msgs 5.3.0 package (ros-jazzy-zed-msgs): the object and skeleton messages published by zedx_driver_ros2. The .msg files are verbatim copies; keep the package name and fields identical, or the Jazzy type hash differs and rmw_zenoh will not connect the topics.
